✨ **Draw strings of low-poly, game-ready fairy lights on any surface.**

**Install**
- Blender 4.2+: `auto_fairy_lights-1.0.0-extension.zip` (drag into Blender, or Get Extensions → Install from Disk)
- Blender 3.6 – 4.1: `auto_fairy_lights-1.0.0.zip` (Preferences → Add-ons → Install)

**Highlights**
- ✏️ Sketch strings with the curve Draw tool, right onto surfaces
- 🔺 8–80 tris per bulb, live tri counter, built for games & VRChat
- 🎨 Glow is its own material slot (single or multi-color) — swap in any Unity shader
- ✨ UV2 = (string position, random seed) per bulb for twinkle/chase/rainbow shaders
- 🖍️ Vertex colors carry bulb color — rainbow strings on one material
- 📦 One-click export prep, FBX/glTF verified
- Tested headless on Blender 3.6.23 / 4.2.22 / 5.1.2 — 40/40 checks green on each

**Site:** https://fairylights.sketch494.online
